turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and why did Owen hear it from his phone?
We are. Who entered it, Hale, and before anyone spoke to Owen?
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.
Late assignments have nothing to do with a Hamlet essay, and you just threatened my son to keep me out of the principal's office. Put that in an email. Now, what do you actually have?
Then it's the principal, today. Last chance: is there a document?
